correctness.rationale: Reconstructed from the actual RESULT.md blob: write g=Su,h=Sv, U=||g||²,Z=||h||²,V=g·h. Exact quotient cross-multiplication is (a-b)(c²-s²)[UZ+cs V(U+Z)]; denominator positivity makes inversion equivalent to 1-r²+rho*w<0 on normalized Wishart coordinates. For k>=2, density (k-1)/(2π)(1-r²-w²)^((k-3)/2) integrates to 1; beta conditioning, Tonelli and Gamma simplification yield the displayed 3F2; k=1 needs a circle law, k=2 elliptic E. Gamma duplication plus dominated convergence proves the fixed-rho (rho/2)^k/sqrt(k) asymptotic. Independently evaluated 8 k/rho hypergeometric-vs-beta/elliptic cases, all matched. rho=1 strict-event endpoint is excluded and discontinuous; independent sketches or joint 2D Ritz eigenvalues are not covered.
